data.one_liner: Network synchronization solution for CRDT data stores over WebSockets.
data.what_it_does: Handles network plumbing between a local CRDT store and a backend. Provides offline-first, real-time synchronization using delta changesets sent over standard WebSockets.
use_when: You need offline-first synchronization with a backend
You are using a CRDT-compatible local store
avoid_when: You do not use CRDTs for your data store
You require traditional REST or GraphQL API communication
strengths: Compatible with all crdt package implementations
Works over standard WebSockets for broad network compatibility
weaknesses: Strictly dependent on the crdt package ecosystem
